author: GameSpot
description:
Experience the high-speed, high-stakes reinvention of racing set in a galaxy far, far away. Pilot a range of speeders and podracers as you make your way through the Galactic League, an unsanctioned racing circuit born in the lawless Outer Rim of the Star Wars galaxy. Developed by Fuse Games and published by Secret Mode, in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games.
 
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is now available worldwide on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
